programme.desc: The fate of the three Brar cousins Angad, Garry and Veer are linked with the three Monga sisters Sahiba, Seerat and Keerat. Seerat, the eldest Monga sister, is pampered by her mother, Santosh, for her beauty. Santosh dreams of getting Seerat married to a rich man. As fate would have it, Angad falls in love with Seerat. However, Seerat is manipulated by Garry and his fake love. On Seerat and Angad's wedding day, Seerat runs away with Garry.

In this sequel to Nyi Blorong (1982 aka The Snake Queen) Brian, a man who believes that money and power will win over the love of his girlfriend. While fleeing through the woods (after attempting rape his now-ex-girlfriend) he stumbles upon the Snake Queen who promises him great wealth if he does her bidding. However the evil hungry snake woman, who wants revenge against the Snake Queen, convinces Brian to trick the Queen by sticking a magic pin in her neck during love making turning her into a snake!

programme.title: VR Fighter
programme.desc: Long Wei has post-traumatic stress disorder after his wife's death. One day, he encounters Amy who works for a VR technology firm and is invited for a new product test. After the test, he becomes the firm's VR fighter.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: The young emperor Kangxi is attempting to select a bride. His mother has arranged for young available women to visit him so that he may choose.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A regime shift in Leka stirs chaos. Police send undercover Zheng Zha into Song Bang’s gang, unaware others are waiting to strike back and settle old scores.

programme.title: Cop Shop Babes
programme.desc: Island East Police Station headed by Madam Lui is known for its “Cop Shop Babes” as all the officers there are female. Two police officers, Beer and Satay, apply for an internal transfer to this station in order to approach the girls. It is at this time that the police receives a bomb threat – can they resolve the case?

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: 36 Secrets Of Courtship
programme.desc: Three lotharios vie to become principal of the Macho Man Training School, an extremely non-monastic institution dedicated to extremely non Shaolin-types of physical exertion.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: Wong Fei-Hung is a mischievous, yet righteous young man, but after a series of incidents, his frustrated father has him disciplined by a master of drunken martial arts.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Centering on Ip Man's migration to Hong Kong in 1949 as he attempts to propagate his discipline of Wing Chun martial arts.

programme.title: The Revenge
programme.desc: Never take your mistress on an annual guys' getaway, especially one devoted to hunting - a violent lesson for three wealthy married men.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: For five years, 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete Toyota AE86 every morning and because of that, he has become a good racer and also unwillingly perfected the art of drifting.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: Justice, My Foot!
programme.desc: Chow stars as Sung, a lawyer who uses any means necessary to help his wealthy clients escape the law. Sung retires to the countryside when urged by his wife, but when Mrs Sung encounters a woman whose husband's death has been covered up by corrupted officials, Sung returns to the court for justice to be served.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. Freaked out by the haunting, the security guards invite ghostbuster Leo and his assistant to help.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: The whole school is held hostage during the day of an English speech competition. As Ip Man decides to step up and rise to the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this.

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Ruthless gangster Guts pulls off a heist of diamonds, then enlists the aid of longtime triad member, Fei, to arrange a buyer for them. But when Guts double crosses the buyer, Fei ends up with the diamonds, wanted by both the cops and Guts.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: When a young man ignores a feng shui master's warning and decides to marry before turning 30, a series of mishaps begins to curse his life.

programme.title: Bangkok Storm
programme.desc: Underground boxer Lin Feng is hunted by the Bangkok triad when he refuses to fight in an illegal match. He escaped successfully but lost his memory.

programme.title: Law Or Justice
programme.desc: A model (Joey Wong) gets raped by a photographer (Wilson Lam). Meanwhile, she falls out with her best friend (Carol Cheng) due to her boyfriend (Alex Man), who's a cop.

programme.title: The Stormriders
programme.desc: An evil warlord takes in 2 students (Wind And Cloud) in an effort to become invincible so he can take over the world.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: Seeding Of A Ghost
programme.desc: A Hong Kong taxi driver's life horribly falls apart after accidentally hitting a sorcerer with his cab. He decides to seek the sorcerer's help to turn the curse on his enemies at the expense of his own life.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: A jester is accidentally recruited by a cult leader to spy on a young and inexperienced Chinese emperor. Things don't go according to plan, and he ends up working for multiple opposing sides while trying to survive the madness.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: This story is set in Shanghai in the late Qing Dynasty, and talks about a young man, Chen Zhen, who rises to become a national hero after enduring hardships and overcoming challenges in life.

programme.title: Green Wood Robbery
programme.desc: Set in the early years of the Republic of China, the wealthy Kang family is brutally murdered, and their young daughter-the sole witness-mysteriously disappears.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fist: Chen Zhen
programme.desc: The year is 1917 and Chen Zhen, believed to be dead, returns to Shanghai under a false name. He joins a mob boss for info on the Japanese incl. a long kill list and at night fights the Japanese masked.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi and PI Lam (Dong jing gong lüe (2000)) steal 2 stolen USD100 plates in HK. Lam loses them - no US reward. Lam and his 3 cute angels try to get them again in Seoul as does JJ. Lots of fighting.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: A rich family's son falls in love with a woman who will only marry him once he becomes a Kung-Fu Master. In this 'Dramedy' He becomes a legendary hero, by attempting to save the emperor, during his true quest of love.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Best friends Bodil and Isabel, apparently happily married, sneak off for secret affairs using each other as an alibi. But when Isabel is killed when they were supposed to have been together. Bodil gets caught up in her own web of lies.

programme.title: The Comeback
programme.desc: Uncle Hua is a retired agent who owns an antique shop on an old street. When the old street is forcibly demolished by the local Green Dragon Gang one day, Uncle Hua's hidden identity is accidentally revealed.

programme.title: Maybe It's Love
programme.desc: 10 year-old Marbles witness the murder of a young woman.

programme.title: The Matrix Revolutions
programme.desc: Neo, Morpheus, dan Trinity bersiap untuk pertempuran terakhir melawan mesin-mesin ganas yang siap menyerang Zion.

programme.title: Spin the Bottle
programme.desc: Saat teman-teman bermain putar botol di sebuah rumah yang bekas lokasi pembantaian, mereka melepaskan roh jahat dan mulai mati dengan cara yang mengerikan.

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 20

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 22

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 23

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 24

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 25
programme.desc: Team Tennyson discovers that a small village's goats are being terrorized by the legendary Chupacabra, but when Ben realizes it's actually Dr. Animo, our hero must thwart the dastardly doctor before he uses the essence of the goats to power up into an unstoppable form!

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 26

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 28

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 29

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 31

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 32

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 33

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 34

programme.title: BEN 10 S3, Ep. 35

programme.desc: Hector Ikut Dengan Tantenya, Diane, Untuk Menghabiskan Satu Tahun Di Hutan Agar Dia Dapat Mempelajari Flora Dan Fauna. Sebagai Seorang Anak Laki-Laki Yang Senang Akan Petualangan, Ia Berteman Baik Dengan Marsupilami Yang Legendaris. Hector Memiliki Keluarga Baru Yang Menyenangkan Dengan Hidup Di Antara Hewan - Hewan Tersebut. Suatu Hari, Kehidupan Barunya Yang Menyenangkan Di Hutan Tiba-Tiba Terancam Dengan Kedatangan Felicia Devort, Seorang Industrialis Megalomaniak Yang Ingin Merusak Hutan Untuk Membangun Kota Devort Di Lokasi Hutan Itu.

programme.title: Blox Buster
programme.desc: Blox Buster Adalah Program Entertainment Yang Menghadirkan Keseruan Bermain Di Dunia Roblox, Platform Game Populer Dengan Jutaan Kreasi Dari Komunitas Global, Penonton Diajak Menjelajahi Berbagai Dunia Virtual Yang Penuh Warna, Menantang, Sekaligus Menyenangkan. Tidak Hanya Sekadar Bermain, Main Bareng Blox Juga Menyuguhkan Pengalaman Unik Dari Para Gamers Yang Ikut Serta, Mulai Dari Review Game, Tips Seru, Hingga Momen-Momen Kejutan Yang Terjadi Saat Bermain.

programme.title: Bread Barbershop
programme.desc: Bread, Seorang Tukang Cukur Jenius, Memecahkan Masalah Penampilan Dengan Keterampilan Memotong Rambutnya Yang Briliant. Sekarang Dia Hadir Untuk Memecahkan Masalah Para Bintang Di Bakery Town. Bertentangan Dengan Penampilan Mereka Yang Glamor Dan Bersinar, Para Selebriti Ini Menjalani Hari Yang Sangat Suram. Bread Dan Keluarganya Siap Membantu Para Selebriti Untuk Menemukan Lagi Kebahagiaan Mereka.

programme.title: Rainbow Ruby
programme.desc: Rainbow Ruby Adalah Kisah Tentang Seorang Gadis Kecil Yang Gagah Dan Banyak Akal Yang Secara Ajaib Diangkut Ke Rainbow 'Village, Tanah Aneh Yang Dihuni Oleh Mainannya, Dan Berubah Menjadi Pekerjaan Yang Berbeda Untuk Membantu Mencegah Bencana . Serial Ini Mengambil Fantasi Masa Kecil Boneka Menjadi Hidup, Dan Bercampur Dalam Pahlawan Wanita Aspiratif Yang Membuktikan Bahwa Anda Bisa Menjadi Apa Pun Yang Anda Inginkan.

programme.title: Nailoong Vs Bombloong
programme.desc: Nailoong Dan Seven Menjalani Kehidupan Damai Hingga Kedatangan Bombloong, Seekor Naga Jahat Yang Ingin Menjadi Yang Terkuat Dan Menimbulkan Kekacauan Di Desa. Mereka Pun Berusaha Sekuat Tenaga Untuk Menghentikan Kejahatan Bombloong.

programme.title: Smurfs
programme.desc: Sebuah Intro Baru Dibuat Untuk Musim Ini. Pertama, Voltaire Tiba Dan Menjatuhkan Brainy , Papa Smurf , Smurfette , Dan Handy Dari Layar. Ketiganya Menunggangi Punggungnya Saat Ia Melewati Penduduk Desa, Petani , Koki , Dan Hefty . Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Dan Brainy Jatuh Dari Voltaire, Yang Diberi Buah Beri Oleh Lily . Sementara Itu, Baby Dan Monkey Menunggangi Diaper Daddy Dengan Gembira. Kemudian, Adegan Beralih Ke Willow , Yang Sedang Melihat Ke Dalam Bola Kristalnya Dan Merasakan Kehadiran Dua Gadis Smurf , Bubble Dan Firefly , Yang Berada Di Gubuk Gargamel, Salah Satunya Bercahaya Dan Yang Lainnya Memiliki Kepang. Penyihir Jahat Itu Datang Untuk Mencoba Menangkapnya Bersama Azrael , Dwayne, Dan Rowena. Firefly Terjebak, Tetapi Secara Ajaib Berteleportasi Ke Tempat Aman Bersama Bubble. Wild Kemudian Digunakan Sebagai Transisi Ke Desa, Dan Layar Penutup Menampilkan Papa Smurf, Smurfette, Brainy, Jokey , Hefty, Clumsy Dan Dimwitty (Sebagai Anggota Pemadam Kebakaran), Blossom , Storm , Wild, Bubble Dan Firefly.
